preprocessing.scope: author-server raw-data replay; identical X.npy and metadata.csv outputs

pretrained_artifacts.scope: saved file integrity and fitted-object structure, not encoder replay

frozen_heads.scope: saved embeddings -> StandardScaler + LogisticRegression -> test predictions; no encoder rerun

crosshar.scope: strict CrossHAR 3-checkpoint loading; classifier inference from retained Z_test representations

hart.scope: full HART inference from X.npy using trained weights and author-server dependency

boundaries: Results match saved test predictions, not a new training of all ten models.
Freshly generated MantisV2/MOMENT-1 encoder embeddings have not been verified.
CrossHAR replay uses saved Z_test features; encoder-feature extraction has not been independently rerun.
HART replay requires original environment, trained checkpoints, BF16 GPU and exact batch_size=1024.
Preprocessing exact hashes demonstrated only against retained original author-side raw-data sources.
No independent clean-machine reproduction of training, robustness, or efficiency experiments is claimed.
